items.period: Shang period (script-style attribution; redraw does not independently date an inscription)
items.caption: Modern vector redraw of 兒 in Shang oracle-script style, linked by its Commons description to Sinica form record 42.F77A.
items.alt: Black line drawing of an oracle-script-style graph identified as 兒.
items.selection_reason: Offers an early-script comparison for the child graph while clearly identifying the image as a modern redraw. It does not settle whether the upper feature depicts a fontanel or hair buns.
items.rights: CC0 1.0/public domain, as stated on the exact Commons file page; the page also attributes the source glyph to Sinica.

items.period: Han-period dictionary tradition, as represented by the Shuowen seal-script form; modern redraw
items.caption: Modern vector rendering of 兒 in Shuowen seal-script style, linked to Sinica record 27.5152.
items.alt: Black line drawing identified as 兒 in Shuowen seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: Pairs with the oracle-script-style candidate to show a later received seal form used in the historical explanation; it is not an artifact photograph and does not prove the depicted anatomy.
items.rights: CC0 1.0/public domain, as stated on the exact Commons file page; the page attributes the source glyph to Sinica.

limitations.text: The SVG originals could not be rendered by the web tool, so the proposed candidates’ pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage.
The exact depicted upper feature remains disputed in the supplied paleographic evidence; neither selected image should be captioned as proving the fontanel or hair-bun interpretation.
